name: Effing Meteors
summary: Effing Meteors is an action game about throwing meteors at planets in order to kill off their native species. Using the mouse, the player can combine small meteors into larger ones, which create a more destructive impact. When all of the life forms on the planet are dead, the player is moved to the next planet. Each planet has different animals on it, which can affect or hinder the player in different ways.
